_about: Copy to profile.json in this folder (FAMILY_DIR) and edit. It is loaded when femi-brain starts: everything except keys starting with _ is given to Claude as context, and every medication becomes a daily reminder. profile.json stays on this laptop (it is git-ignored).

_fields.family: how to refer to the household
_fields.home: city or area, used for weather, news and bookings
_fields.notes: anything Femi should always keep in mind
_fields.members[]: name (what people call them), relation (to the family, e.g. grandmother, son, 8-year-old daughter), notes (age, likes, how to talk to them, contact names Fo knows them by)
_fields.medications[]: who (a member name), time (HH:MM, 24-hour, local), what (medicine and dose, spoken aloud), escalate_to (optional: who Fo should text if the reminder is not tapped within FEMI_ACK_MINUTES, default 10)

notes: Dinner is usually at 8 pm. Riya has school Monday to Friday.
